mutant.description: FOUR mutant/negative-control families, each built so a check that would otherwise be vacuous can fail. (1) inv-6: perfrp_rollup.summed_returns_MUTANT -- the real wrong law IMPORTED rather than re-typed, so it cannot drift from what it models. (2) ROLLUP ALIGNMENT: a dated parent against what positional alignment would produce on the same children. (3) PII: a planted sensitive column (mstracct_number) in a projected transactions row. (4) COST BASIS: the runner-up column scored against the same identity that named the winner. Every mutant is paired with a POSITIVE CONTROL so an implementation that refused everything could not pass.
